mapper.select: select id, user_id, target_type, target_id, content, review_status, reject_reason, review_time, reviewer_id, create_time, update_time from `comment` where id = #{id} limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into `comment` (user_id, target_type, target_id, content, review_status, reject_reason, review_time, reviewer_id, create_time, update_time) values (#{userId}, #{targetType}, #{targetId}, #{content}, #{reviewStatus}, #{rejectReason}, #{reviewTime}, #{reviewerId}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.update: update `comment` set review_status = #{reviewStatus}, reject_reason = #{rejectReason}, review_time = now(), reviewer_id = #{reviewerId}, update_time = now() where id = #{id}
